thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: elevated 5xx rate for customer auric-enterprise (VPC) in eu-west-1. Error spike started ~10:12 UTC. Severity: SEV2. Paging on-call.

lina (oncall-sre): I’m on it. seeing ~8% 5xx at the ingress for auric pool, latency stable. Dedicated GPU pool for auric shows connection resets.

amar (sre-lead): tagging in — thanks Lina. any recent deploys to auric’s ingress or LB?

lina (oncall-sre): deploy-bot shows no model or runtime deploys in the last 3 hours. ingress config changed 14h ago but stable until now. logs show TLS handshake failures and backend gRPC resets.

rafa (netops): checking network path. I can see intermittent packet drops at eu-west-1 AZ-b to host range for the dedicated pool. Might be noisy NIC or hypervisor-level issue.

zoe (solutions-eng): notified Auric account. Mike, can you confirm if they are seeing errors on their side?

mike (acct-mgr): pinged customer via DM and scheduled a quick call. They report degraded API responses (timeouts + 502s). They’re on standby for a controlled failover if we recommend.

lina (oncall-sre): triage plan: 1) Isolate tenant traffic from affected dedicated pool 2) Shift traffic to warm pool in eu-central-1 (pre-warmed for auric) 3) Update DNS TTL to accelerate cutover and create staged CNAME to warm ingress 4) Monitor errors -> target <0.5% 5xx. starting step 1 now.

sam (observability): creating temporary dashboard and alert: auric-5xx-rate, auric-latency-p50/p95, backend-reset-rate. hooking in tracing for request ids.

lina (oncall-sre): running drain command to stop new sessions to the faulty nodes:

```
kubectl -n auric-dedicated scale deployment/auric-ingress --replicas=0 --context=eu-west-1
# then mark pool as in-maintenance in infra UI
```

deploy-bot: rollback job queued: ingress-config-v1.9 -> v1.8 for auric pool. will attempt only if drain+shift doesn't stabilize.

rafa (netops): prepared NAT/route adjustments. warming up eu-central-1 pool now — expected warm capacity 80% of peak within 3 minutes. I've reserved the warm GPU set. IPs: [10.12.33.45, 10.12.33.46] (internal).

zoe (solutions-eng): suggested DNS plan to reduce propagation time: lower customer route53 TTL to 60, create new A records pointing to warm ingress, then incrementally shift via weighted records (100 -> 0). propose 10% steps every 30s with checks.

lina (oncall-sre): agreed. execute TTL change and create weighted record set. samp code to apply:

```
aws route53 change-resource-record-sets --hosted-zone-id Z0123456 --change-batch '{"Changes":[{"Action":"UPSERT","ResourceRecordSet":{"Name":"api.auric.example.com","Type":"A","TTL":60,"SetIdentifier":"auric-warm-eu-central","Weight":10,"ResourceRecords":[{"Value":"34.201.12.8"}]}}]}'
```

rafa (netops): TTL lowered to 60. warm pool healthy, backend checks passing. initiating weighted shifts: +10% -> monitor.

sam (observability): first 10% shift in progress. 5xx dropped from 8% -> 3.2% within 45s. p95 latency unchanged. traces show fewer TLS resets on shifted traffic.

mike (acct-mgr): on call with Auric execs — they want full cutover ASAP but want confirmation no regression on warm pool. They asked for a short maintenance note for their ops team.

eve (customer-success): sending an interim status update to customer: "We’re shifting traffic to a healthy warm pool to mitigate errors; no data loss expected. We’ll follow up when cutover complete." :phone:

lina (oncall-sre): proceeding with next increments: +25% -> monitor for 30s.

sam (observability): after +25% shift total 35% traffic: 5xx down to 1.1%, error budget within SLO for auric. no new backend resets on warm pool.

amar (sre-lead): good. plan to continue to 100% in staged jumps. Lina hand off to me in ~10m for the rotation/communication with infra for final DNS set and to coordinate postmortem.

lina (oncall-sre): handing off — leaving prepared runbook and checklist in incident doc. :white_check_mark: all immediate mitigations executed. passing pager to Amar.

amar (sre-lead): taking over. will perform the final weighted shifts to 100% and then decommission problematic hosts. Rafael, can you confirm we can keep warm pool for 2h for rollback window?

rafa (netops): yes, warm pool reserved + autoscale holds for 2h. I've also flagged the eu-west-1 hosts for hardware investigation.

deploy-bot: ingress-config rollback not required — traffic fully shifted to warm pool. leaving rollback job queued but on hold.

amar (sre-lead): final shift to 100% in 3...2...1...

sam (observability): 100% shift complete. auric 5xx at 0.08%. p50/p95 within baseline. no regression found.

amar (sre-lead): I’m going to run the node evacuation + host quarantine steps for eu-west-1 auric nodes:

```
# mark hosts as quarantined
infractl host set-state --hostpool auric-eu-west --state quarantined --reason "network err spike"
# trigger ticket for hardware team
```

rafa (netops): done. hardware ticket created (HW-7821). on-call hardware engineer paged.

mike (acct-mgr): customer confirmed their traffic is stable and they’re ok with us keeping warm pool for rollback for 2 hours. they requested a short incident summary once we’re stable.

eve (customer-success): scheduling a post-incident call with Auric in 4 hours to walk the timeline and next steps.

amar (sre-lead): current status: mitigated — traffic shifted to warm eu-central-1 pool, DNS weighted records set to 100% for warm ingress. warm pool reserved 2h. eu-west-1 hosts quarantined for hw inspection. next: postmortem and remediation plan for NIC/hypervisor flakiness.

sam (observability): saving timeline & traces to incident archive. will attach dashboards and key spans.

amar (sre-lead): closing incident channel in 30m if no regression. action items: 1) infra follow-up (HW-7821) 2) runbook update for staged DNS cutover (reduce TTL step added) 3) cost ops - billable warm hours reconciliation 4) postmortem and exec summary for Auric.

lina (oncall-sre): closing notes: shoutout to Rafa and Sam for fast warm provisioning. good coordination. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: severity downgraded to SEV4 — mitigated. Incident channel will remain open for followups.

amar (sre-lead): ack. moving to follow-up task board. thanks everyone. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
